in_sanskrit.name: प्रतिक्षा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: the act of seeing or observing, waiting for, or the feeling of anticipation and desire for something to happen

in_hindi.name: प्रतिक्षा
in_hindi.meaning: अपनी ताकता की आगे वाथी के लिए दर्शन देना
in_hindi.long_meaning: to show one's taatka (a sign or omen) to someone, to give a sign or indication, to wait for, to hope for, to expect

in_tamil.name: பிரதீஷா
in_tamil.long_meaning: something that is longed for, a desire, a wish, an expectation

in_marathi.name: Pratiksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pratiksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pratiksha is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'pratiksh' meaning to wait for, hope, or expect. It is a name given to a child believed to bring good fortune and a hopeful future. The name is also associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, symbolizing wisdom, knowledge, and learning.
